name: Swedish Championship 2020

venue.name: [Huskvarna Folkets Park](https://huskvarnafolketspark.se/)
venue.details: Main events will be held in the room Storparketten, on the ground floor. Long events will be held in nearby side rooms.

information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2020! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 8 sekunder eller 5 minuter.

Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla 17 WCA-grenar. Om du inte tänker delta i 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 FMC, 3x3x3 Multi-BLD eller Megaminx så behöver du inte vara på plats i Huskvarna under fredagen.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Observera: I år kommer det finnas kvalgränser i grenarna 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD och 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. Mer information under detta under fliken "kvalgränser".

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, prispengar och titeln Svensk Mästare.

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2020! Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 8 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year will be a 3 day competition, hosting all 17 WCA events. If you are not competiting in 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 FMC, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind or Megaminx, then there is no need to be present in Huskvarna on Friday.

Please read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information. Please note: For this year´s edition, there will be qualification limits for the following events: 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD and 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. More information on this can be found under the tab "qualification limits". 

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, however only competitors representing Sweden are eligeble for medals, prize money and the Swedish Champion titles.
